input.subject: Refund Cancelled Order
input.body: Hey ByteMart, I received an email stating that my order was cancelled due to inventory shortage and that a full refund had been initiated. It has been 2 days, but I have not received the refund in my HDFC Bank account. Could you please check the refund status and let me know when I can expect the amount to be credited?
